atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Injects Tailwind's base, components, utilities, and variants styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tells Tailwind which "bucket" a set of custom styles belong to (base, components, utilities).

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, breakpoints, etc.) as CSS variables that also generate corresponding utility classes. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Registers a custom utility class, including ones that support Tailwind variants like hover: and dark:. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant to styles inside a custom CSS rule or custom utility. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom variant selector (e.g. a class-based dark mode variant). Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @slot
atDirectives.description: Placeholder marking where the content passed to a @custom-variant or @utility block should be inserted. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript Tailwind plugin from CSS. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript Tailwind config file from CSS. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Explicitly adds a source file/glob that Tailwind should scan for classes, or excludes one. Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports theme variables and custom utilities without duplicating CSS output, for use in scoped styles. Tailwind CSS v4.
